Nine created this part with the knowledge that the best soldiers can
push themselves to perform beyond their best abilities. When equipped,
you feel as though a power greater than you can handle has been unleashed.
Knowing that speed, strength, and endurance are crucial to victory,
Nine developed this part. This boost system provides balanced enhancement
to all three qualities during battle.
Nine knows that logistical support is key to winning battles. To
that end, she created the ultimate backup part. It's packed with
supplies and repair equipment, and can even be equipped on combat units.
Nine designed this part to test her theory that exacting tactical
orders are the key to emerging victorious. This automated battle
analyzation system is capable of emulating even the best tacticians.
Out of respect for the notion that attrition is one way to win
a war, Nine created this part in order to better protect pilots.
This extra armor increases a unit's durability.
Well aware that physical defenses alone do not ensure survival,
Nine developed a part designed to resist a wide variety of enemy attacks.
Mastering this composite armor system requires considerable skill.
Nine understands that hand-to-hand combat requires raw strength and
footwork, so she crafted this part to advance that theory. It combines
servomotors for better articulation with superior forward boosters.
Nine knows that good visibility and concentration are essential to
ranged attacks, and she designed this part with that in mind. It fuses
precise alignment sensors with advanced target analysis systems.
While Nine is skeptical of the math behind the theory that "Three times
the revolutions equals three times the power," she nonetheless designed
this effector to channel the energy emitted from weapons into a spiral.
Nine made this part to try and dispel the sense of regret people
have felt at falling just short of their goals. This all-purpose power
management system can increase the range of any and all weapons.
This part was designed to convert the intense desires of human pilots
into raw power. This booster is powerful enough to bulldoze any
and all enemies, albeit with tremendous noise. Stealthy, it is not.
Nine designed this part around the idea that a little kindness goes
a long way toward building a large allied force. This system
disperses nanomachines that repair and resupply any nearby allies.
Nine knows that an outage or short-circuit can spell certain doom,
so she created a high-output external generator capable of producing
a massive amount of energy each minute.
Nine designed this part to prevent a robot's clips from ever emptying,
which can end a pilot's life as quickly as anything else.
This high-capacity system can create any kind of ammo in just one minute.
Having heard the phrase "Money makes the world go around," Nine
engineered this part to help out with the finances. This system pulls
in any valuable objects, both earning money and keeping the area clean.
Aware that Ace Pilots are unmatched in their piloting ability, Nine
designed a part that gives other pilots a taste. This pilot assistance
system can also gather data from other pilots to improve its own systems.
Nine has heard some talk of a hidden power that lies deep within
humans, and she is determined to harness it for use in battle.
This specialized interface uses the pilot's desires to drive the robot.
Having studied the many pitfalls that pilots find themselves trapped in,
Nine designed this part. It is a type of camphor with the potential to
turn the tide of battle. Handy when you find yourself against the wall.
Nine has heard that a positive attitude can work wonders, so she
designed a part that translates that to the battlefield. This system
takes the pilot's delight over raised ExC and translates it into more ExC.
Tapping into the endorphins released when a pilot destroys an enemy,
Nine designed this part to provide extra positive feedback. The resulting
feedback loop can be dangerous, however, and should be used sparingly.
Nine was inspired to craft this part upon observing that humans pride
themselves on their courage in the face of adversity. This part is
packed with encouragement from Nine to help you face large enemies.
The phrase "psychological warfare" has stuck with Nine, who designed
this part as a way to try it out. It uses extremely unpleasant sounds
to try and unsettle or break the enemy.
Upon receiving lots of positive feedback about the parts she designed,
Nine created this part as a token of her gratitude.
It contains a program that temporarily boosts monetary collection.
Having read legends of fairies and sprites bringing good fortune,
Nine is determined to become something similar. This small, Nine-
shaped computer provides emotional support from the cockpit.
